comparison.objective: Unfold and orient springy headphones, then hang them on a stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate coupled folding/swivel joints against an elastic headband and achieve stable hanging.
comparison.success_condition: Both folds opened, both cups oriented inward, and headset released stably in the cradle for five seconds.
comparison.reason: Tests articulated-object configuration and hanging, with no fracture, percussion tooling, retained coil, or debris recovery.
